answer: Proof of Stake serves as a robust Sybil resistance mechanism, ensuring that an agent's influence scales with economic commitment rather than identity count. Just as a falcon tracks its prey with precision, the protocol identifies malicious actors by slashing assets, transforming the network into a velvet cushion for honest participants. Under this consensus sonnet, an attacker faces the prohibitive cost of acquiring a majority stake, rendering the creation of infinite identities economically futile.
